label: Webscraper Io
description: Manage cloud sitemaps, scraping jobs, schedules, tags, and data exports

operations.name: list_sitemaps
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of sitemaps for the authenticated user's organization.

operations.name: import_sitemap
operations.description: Imports a sitemap from raw JSON content and creates a new sitemap.

operations.name: get_sitemap
operations.description: Returns details for a single sitemap by ID.

operations.name: update_sitemap
operations.description: Updates sitemap JSON for an existing sitemap.

operations.name: delete_sitemap
operations.description: Deletes a sitemap.

operations.name: rename_sitemap
operations.description: Renames a sitemap and updates related scraping job sitemap names.

operations.name: get_scheduler
operations.description: Returns scheduler configuration for a sitemap.

operations.name: enable_scheduler
operations.description: Enables sitemap scheduler with the provided cron and execution settings.

operations.name: disable_scheduler
operations.description: Disables sitemap scheduler.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: Returns tags assigned to a sitemap.

operations.name: add_tag
operations.description: Adds a tag to a sitemap.

operations.name: remove_tag
operations.description: Removes a tag from a sitemap.

operations.name: create_scraping_job
operations.description: Creates a new scraping job for a sitemap.

operations.name: list_scraping_jobs
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of scraping jobs for the authenticated user's organization.

operations.name: get_scraping_job
operations.description: Returns details for a single scraping job by ID

operations.name: delete_scraping_job
operations.description: Deletes a scraping job.

operations.name: list_problematic_urls
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of problematic URLs for the scraping job.

operations.name: download_data
operations.description: Streams scraping job data as a downloadable file.

operations.name: get_data_quality
operations.description: Returns data quality statistics for a scraping job.

operations.name: continue_scraping_job
operations.description: Continues a stopped or pausable scraping job. All parameters are optional. Any parameter that is not provided keeps the scraping job's current value.

operations.name: stop_scraping_job
operations.description: Stops a running or pausable scraping job.

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Returns account details for the authenticated user.
